title: Advisor plan
description: Issue #1175 and #1475: the plan record at clossys/advisor/plan.json that Advisor writes and renders into its STATUS document, and that Launcher reads before it applies an approved plan. packages/advisor/src/status.ts's AdvisorPlan type is the shape's owner; this file is the one definition both @clossys/advisor and @clossys/launcher validate against (each package packs it at build time, so neither depends on the other). Every object is closed: a key this contract does not declare is refused, never ignored, because an unknown key is either a typo or a field some other reader would silently drop. A later field is added here first, in the same change as its reader. The canonical plan digest, which an approval binds, is defined in docs/contracts/advisor-plan-digest.md; its fixture corpus is docs/contracts/advisor-plan-digest.fixture.json.

asOf.description: When this plan record was last written. Excluded from the canonical plan digest.

recommendedNext.description: The one pending step for the whole plan, or null once nothing is pending.

decisions.description: What was recommended, what was chosen, when, and by whom. The plan is approved when the most recent entry by `at` has chosen "approved". Excluded from the canonical plan digest, because an approval is itself recorded here.

nonBlankString.title: a string with at least one non-whitespace character

dateTime.title: an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone, such as 2026-09-24T12:00:00Z

dateOrDateTime.title: an ISO 8601 date such as 2026-09-24, or a date-time with a time zone such as 2026-09-24T12:00:00Z

problem.description: The client's problem, in their own words.

blockerKind.description: The five blocker kinds of the Controller loop record (docs/contracts/loop.json), in their fixed order.

blocker.description: One capability at rest with exactly one next action. Field for field the same shape as the Controller loop record's Blocker.
